headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.2 innings of scoreless relief. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates took down the St. Louis Cardinals 6-2 behind Braxton Ashcraft's 7.0 innings of work, and the New York Mets edged out the Washington Nationals 2-1.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Brenton Doyle, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies due to a left oblique contusion. The Atlanta Braves have transferred Hurston Waldrep to the 60-day injured list after right elbow surgery. Other injured players include Victor Vodnik (Colorado Rockies), Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays), Kyle Teel (Chicago White Sox), Lance McCullers Jr. (Houston Astros), James McCann (Arizona Diamondbacks), and Joe Mantiply (Toronto Blue Jays).

The Cincinnati Reds made a roster move ahead of their series, trading RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins in exchange for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn, while the Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash. The Athletics traded CF Junior Perez to the Chicago White Sox for LHP Jackson Nove.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.2 innings of scoreless relief. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cardinals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Braxton Ashcraft leading the way on the mound. Ashcraft pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 9 batters while allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Nationals in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the Washington Nationals 2-1, securing a crucial win. David Peterson earned the win for the Mets, while Devin Williams secured the save.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Marlins 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a dominant 9-3 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Michael Harris II leading the charge at the plate. Harris II hit two home runs, including his 11th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Rockies CF Brenton Doyle Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies center fielder Brenton Doyle has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique contusion, effective retroactive to May 20, 2026.

top_news.title: **Reds Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins in exchange for RHP Zach McCambley on May 21, 2026.
